note: Trivial glue submodule of acquia_dam with NO UI, config, permissions, or Drush of its own. It adds entity insert/update/delete hooks that run pluggable asset_detector-tagged services (MediaReference/EntityEmbedText/Paragraphs) to discover DAM assets in content, then delegates to the parent's IntegrationLinkRegister which queues work in the acquia_dam_integration_links queue. Actual link registration calls the DAM API and needs a live connection, so the medium/hard cases avoid the API entirely: medium reads the depth of the local acquia_dam_integration_links Drupal queue this submodule feeds; hard checks that the submodule itself is enabled (a real, verifiable core.extension state). Per the campaign the submodule is left UNINSTALLED at baseline, so the hard reset/cleanup uninstall it and the queue exists regardless (its worker lives in the parent). Counts 3 easy / 1 medium / 1 hard as a trivial submodule.

evals.prompt: What does the Acquia DAM 'Enhanced integration links' submodule add on top of the base acquia_dam module's asset-usage tracking?
evals.expected_output: The parent tracks direct media entities; this submodule deep-discovers DAM assets referenced anywhere in content - entity-reference fields, nested paragraphs, and Entity Embed in rich text - across all content entity types, registering accurate integration links back to the DAM.

evals.prompt: How does the Enhanced integration links submodule detect DAM assets when content is saved, and how would a developer extend that detection to a custom field structure?
evals.expected_output: On hook_entity_insert/update/delete it runs services tagged 'asset_detector' (collected by AssetTracker) - MediaReferenceAssetDetector, EntityEmbedTextDetector, ParagraphsAssetDetector. To extend it, register a new service with the 'asset_detector' tag implementing AssetDetectorInterface.

evals.prompt: When should a site enable the Enhanced integration links submodule, and when is it unnecessary? Does it require any configuration?
evals.expected_output: Enable it on sites with complex/nested content: paragraphs with media, Entity Embed in WYSIWYG, or references across many content types. Skip it on simple sites that only use direct media entities (to avoid per-save scanning overhead). It has no UI and needs no configuration - it works automatically once enabled.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, how many items are currently waiting in the 'acquia_dam_integration_links' queue that the enhanced integration links submodule feeds? Inspect the live queue to answer.
evals.expected_output: There are 2 items in the acquia_dam_integration_links queue (drush queue:list, or \Drupal::queue('acquia_dam_integration_links')->numberOfItems()).

evals.prompt: This site needs accurate Acquia DAM asset-usage tracking across paragraphs and embedded media, which requires the Enhanced integration links submodule. Make sure that submodule is enabled on the site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the submodule: drush en acquia_dam_integration_links -y (it depends on acquia_dam, which is already enabled). Verified via \Drupal::moduleHandler()->moduleExists('acquia_dam_integration_links').
